about_the_game: Embark on a pioneering journey to build the first interstellar orbital settlement. Light-years away from your home star, supplies are scarce, and survival is in your hands. Mine resources, process materials, conduct research, and construct stations and spacecraft. Master the complex mechanics of orbital dynamics to maintain and expand your outpost, all while overcoming the relentless challenges of deep space.

short_description: A sci-fi settlement building game with orbital mechanics. Start from a spaceship, scan asteroids, manage fuel, ore, electricity, time, and sanity, while expanding your settlement, exploring an alien solar system, and building stations and spacecraft to support your growing colony.
